description: Preserve recognized local protected People page destinations across the existing signed-cookie OTP flow without changing authentication or authorization. Tests first; reject unsafe redirect inputs; clear continuation after use/logout; preserve BO/Person isolation. Action reuse: extend existing PersonAuth plug and PersonSessionController flow; destination policy is web-local because it governs Phoenix routes/session redirects, has no domain/workflow contract, and must not be agent-exposed. Existing auth dispatch remains authoritative. E2E scope is coordinated through zaq-jrg.31 -> zaq-jrg.32.
title: Preserve People portal destinations through login
